Priya: Quick weekly pulse for ClarionHealth — noticed uptick in errors this morning during their midday peak. 5xx up to 4.3% (baseline 0.6%), timeouts ~2.1%, and a handful of rate-limited requests hitting their retry loop. Top failing endpoints from logs: /v1/generate (44% of 5xx), /v1/embeddings (26%), /v1/chat/stream (12%).
Ben: Thanks — they're mid-onboard and ramping usage, might be heavy batched embeddings from a nightly job. I asked product to pause the bulk run but haven't heard back.
Aisha: Can you paste the query you used for the top endpoints? I want to correlate with error type (503 vs 504 vs 429).
Priya: Sure — ran a quick rollup from our metrics: `SELECT path, error_code, count(*) FROM api_logs WHERE account = 'clarion' AND ts >= now()-24h GROUP BY path, error_code ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10`
Marco: Quick update from runtime side: we saw a model fallback loop and <10s spikes in kv-cache misses after the 08:12 deploy. That produced backend 502s and some request timeouts while workers spun up. Pushing a rollback now.
OpsBot: alert: clarion-prod: spike in 5xx rate at 2026-02-14T08:15:03Z — created incident #CS-2987
Ben: If the nightly job is the driver, suggest we enable batching throttle on their agent and increase client timeout to 90s for embeddings. That should reduce concurrent pressure.
Aisha: Also seeing ~600 429s across /v1/embeddings — maybe their client is retrying aggressively. Can we check whether the retry-after header was respected?
Marco: Found mismatched timeout in their SDK config — retries disabled, but exponential backoff misconfigured, so retries landed right into the concurrency cap. I've opened a support ticket with the onboarding engineer to change default to `Retry-After` honoring.
Priya: Heads-up for renewal: Clarion has a renewal review next quarter. If we stabilize by end of next week and share a short RCA + mitigation plan, that should remove churn risk.
Jake: Can someone own the RCA draft? I'll join customer call tomorrow. Priya, Ben — can you co-author and include action items: pause bulk job, SDK config change, longer client timeout, and temporary quota bump?
Ben: I can take the pause/coordination item. Will confirm with their SRE and product.
Aisha: I'll attach the metrics query + sample logs to the RCA. Also will include a small analytics snippet they can run client-side to verify backoff behavior.
Marco: Rolling back the 08:12 deploy now. I'll monitor 5xx and post a follow-up in 20m.
Priya: Thanks team. Next check-in here in 24h or sooner if numbers don't fall. :thumbsup:
Marco: follow-up: rollback completed at 08:29, initial drop in 5xx seen (now 1.2%). Continuing to watch.
OpsBot: update: incident #CS-2987 resolved by rollback and SDK config change.
Priya: Great — I'll draft RCA and ping Jake for review before the customer call.
Jake: on it, thanks everyone.
